summary: PrivDeploy: grant cross-account IAM roles, KMS and env permissions for new private deployment onboarding
description:
Issue summary: New private deployment onboarding for customer 'BeaconHealth' requires cross-account IAM roles in both AWS and GCP, plus KMS key access and scoped S3/GCS read permissions. Impact: deployment cannot be completed for Dedicated/Private offering until credentials and role delegation are configured. Environment: private control plane connecting to customer VPCs in us-east-1 and europe-west1; staging and prod clusters use separate AWS accounts and one GCP project for telemetry.

Requested by: Solutions Engineering (Lena Novak).

Desired outcome:
- Create/approve cross-account IAM role in Redwood AWS org with limited assume-role trust to the Private deployment account and SolutionsEng principal.
- Grant KMS:Decrypt and GenerateDataKey for the specific CMKs used by private deployments in prod and staging.
- Create GCP service account with Workload Identity binding and allow impersonation from Redwood control plane service account.
- Attach least-privilege policies for S3/GCS read access to model artifacts buckets, and logging write to dedicated logging buckets.

Business justification: Customer onboarding is schedule-bound (integration window next week). This is an internal support access request tied to a paid private deployment contract.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Attempted deployment via private-deploy CLI in staging: command fails during artifact sync step.
2) Error: 'AccessDenied: not authorized to use CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/xxxx' and 'PermissionDenied: serviceAccount X cannot impersonate'.
3) Verified that the service account/role mapping was not present in target customer-connected accounts.
4) Reproduced in both staging and prod accounts with same failure patterns.
logs:
aws-cli error snippet: [2026-03-09T16:12:04Z] botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Decrypt operation: User: arn:aws:sts::444555666:assumed-role/rdw-private-deploy-role/session is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/xxxx.
GCP error: permissionDenied: Service account projects/-/serviceAccounts/rdw-control@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have permission to impersonate serviceAccount:beacon-private-sa@beacon-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed via AWS CloudTrail that assume-role attempts reach the target account but fail on kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey due to CMK key policy (key policy currently restricts to account root + explicit admin role).
- Checked IAM role trust policy: Redwood role exists but the principal list omits the SolutionsEng role in some staging accounts (race during templatized account bootstrap).
- GCP: Workload Identity pool binding present in prod but not in staging; service account impersonation permission (roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator) missing for rdw-control SA.
- Hypothesis: recent bootstrap changes to account templates removed automatic KMS key grants and Workload Identity bindings for private deployments. See infra commit 1a2b3c linked above.
- Risk: If we grant broader KMS permissions, we could exceed least-privilege. Need to patch CMK policy with explicit role ARNs only for the deployment role and time-bound elevation where possible.
comments: Lena Novak (Solutions Eng) - 2026-03-10: Customer integration window is 2026-03-17; we need confirmation of ETA for role creation.
Aisha Patel (IAM/Security) - 2026-03-10: Adding this to internal access queue. Will validate least-privilege policy draft and return with required ARNs.

Dana Ortiz (SRE Lead) - 2026-03-11: Noted inconsistency across bootstrapped accounts. Team will prepare a small corrective repo change; prefer role-only CMK policy updates rather than opening key to account.

Marco Liu (Cloud Infra) - 2026-03-12: Created PRs for role mapping and KMS policy adjustments. Need review from security. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/872 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/iam-roles/pull/211.

Aisha Patel (IAM/Security) - 2026-03-12: Reviewed PRs and left comments requesting time-limited condition on assume-role and audit tag for every assume. Also requested GCP service account binding template for reproducibility.
resolution_notes:
Workaround: Solutions Eng used a manual temporary admin API key in staging to complete artifact sync for BeaconHealth while infra prepared least-privilege fixes. Permanent fix steps applied: 1) Updated CMK key policy to include explicit allow for rdw-private-deploy-role ARN in both prod and staging CMKs, with kms:ViaService condition to reduce blast radius. 2) Applied roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator to rdw-control@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com on the Beacon GCP project for the beacon-private-sa service account and added Workload Identity binding template. 3) Deployed infra PRs that patch account bootstrap templates to include KMS grants and Workload Identity bindings for future accounts. 4) Created follow-up ticket INT-5390 to add automated verification in account bootstrap CI.
Post-action verification: deployment completed successfully in staging and prod for BeaconHealth on 2026-03-12. No further permission errors observed.
Follow-ups: schedule a cross-team review (SRE, Security, Solutions Eng) to standardize CMK key policies and Workload Identity templates.
